card.essence: Pre-eminent trauma remedy for mechanical injuries, blows, falls, overexertion—recent or remote. Sore, bruised aching pervades the whole body; bed feels too hard, patient constantly shifts position. Morose, fears touch or approach, says 'nothing wrong with me' when seriously ill. Tendency to haemorrhage, ecchymosis, septic states. Apoplexy with hot red face and cool body. Unconscious, answers correctly then relapses into stupor.
card.sides: Left upper extremity and right chest affinity

keynotes.text: Bed feels too hard; must constantly change position seeking a soft spot
Says 'there is nothing the matter with me' in serious illness
Fears touch or approach of anyone; morose, wants to be let alone
Unconscious; answers correctly when spoken to, then relapses into stupor
Sore, lame, bruised feeling all through body as if beaten
Hot head/face with cold body or extremities
Black and blue spots; ecchymosis and tendency to haemorrhage
Trauma—physical or emotional (grief, remorse, financial loss)
Septic conditions, putrid phenomena; foul breath, taste, stool

modalities_worse.text: Touch or jarring; injuries, bruises, shocks

modalities_better.text: Lying with head low or outstretched

mentals: Morose, irritable, repellant; wants to be let alone
Fears touch, being struck, sudden death, instant death on waking
Indifference; says nothing ails him when seriously ill
Cannot bear pain; whole body oversensitive
Mental strain or shock; traumatism of grief, remorse, financial loss
Horrors at night; wakes grasping heart with fear of sudden death
Dreams of muddy water, robbers, nightmares; falls asleep mid-sentence
physicals: Sore, bruised aching everywhere; joints as if sprained
Hot red face, apoplexy, cerebral congestion; cool body below
Haemorrhages: retinal, conjunctival, epistaxis, haematemesis, haemoptysis
Ecchymosis, black and blue spots from minor injuries
Septic conditions, abscesses that do not mature, putrid phenomena
Fetid breath, taste like rotten eggs, offensive flatus and stool
Involuntary stool and urine in stupor states
Muscular and tendinous rheumatism, especially back and shoulders
Sore nipples, bruised parts after labour; violent after-pains
Hoarseness from overuse of voice; cough from weeping or cardiac lesion
Angina pectoris with pain severe in left elbow
Small painful boils, one after another; crops of boils
Cold spot on forehead; cold nose; tinnitus aurium
clinical: Injuries, falls, blows, contusions—recent or remote sequelae
Post-traumatic concussion, meningitis, stupor with involuntary evacuations
Apoplexy with full red face; controls haemorrhage, aids absorption
Typhoid states with stupor, mottled skin, putrid odour
Scarlet fever when eruption does not appear; dusky mottled skin
Labour: soreness after delivery, prevents post-partum haemorrhage
Retention or incontinence of urine after labour
Bruised sore throat in diphtheria (consider Phytolacca if marked)
Pneumonia, pleurodynia, all chest bones and cartilages painful
Cardiac dropsy with distressing dyspnoea; weakened heart muscle
Malignant or congestive intermittent fevers in malarial regions
Compound fractures with profuse suppuration (use with Calendula)
Retinal or conjunctival haemorrhage from injury or cough
Gout and rheumatism with fear of being touched
Dysentery with ischuria, fruitless urging, long intervals between stools

differentials.note: Both stupor answering then relapsing, dark tongue streak, hard bed. Baptisia: tosses about, cannot get himself together, extremely offensive discharges. Arnica: involuntary stool/urine, ecchymoses under skin.
Both soreness, restlessness. Rhus: stiffness < initial motion, > continued motion, damp conditions cause. Arnica: trauma origin, bed feels hard, wants to be let alone.
Both sore bruised all over head to foot. Phytolacca: diphtheritic throat, heat of head with cool body. Arnica: trauma history, ecchymosis, stupor states.
Both fear after shock. Opium: fear persists daytime, painlessness. Arnica: fear in nightmares, extreme soreness, morose irritability.
Both bruised soreness, restlessness in bed. Ruta: cartilages, tendons, periosteum; eyestrain. Arnica: muscles, trauma, haemorrhage tendency.
Related remedy; follows well after Arnica in certain cases.

cautions: Acts feebly in debilitated persons with impoverished blood and soft flesh
Local use may produce extraordinary hair growth (Ussher)
Should not be given for bruises indiscriminately—symptom picture must match
Misused remedy when limited only to bruises without constitutional indications
